id.description: Unique identifier for the component. Defaults to None when omitted.

className.description: CSS class applied to the component container. Defaults to None when omitted.

style.description: Inline styles applied to the component container. Defaults to None when omitted.

option.description: ECharts option object. Defaults to None when omitted.

maps.description: GeoJSON or SVG map definitions registered before applying the option. Defaults to None when omitted.

enable_gl.description: Lazily load ECharts-GL before applying 3D/WebGL options. Defaults to false.

gl_bundle_url.description: Optional URL override for the separately served ECharts-GL bundle. Defaults to None when omitted.

notMerge.description: Replace the current option instead of merging it. Defaults to false.

lazyUpdate.description: Defer option updates until the next animation frame. Defaults to false.

renderer.description: Rendering engine used by ECharts. Defaults to "canvas".

theme.description: Named light/dark theme or a custom ECharts theme object. Defaults to None when omitted.

click_data.description: Latest click event with seriesIndex, dataIndex, name, and value when available. Defaults to None when omitted.

dblclick_data.description: Latest double-click event with seriesIndex, dataIndex, name, and value when available. Defaults to None when omitted.

hover_data.description: Latest pointer-over event with seriesIndex, dataIndex, name, and value when available. Defaults to None when omitted.

selected_data.description: Latest selection-change event, including the selected series and data indexes. Defaults to None when omitted.

legend_status.description: Latest legend selection event with the legend name and selection state. Defaults to None when omitted.

zoom_data.description: Latest data-zoom event with range and value bounds when available. Defaults to None when omitted.

dispatch_action.description: Dispatch a supported ECharts action when this payload changes. Defaults to None when omitted.

append_data.description: Append a batch of data to an ECharts series without resending its full option. Defaults to None when omitted.

ref.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
@,see,,{@link ,https://react.dev/learn/referencing-values-with-refs#refs-and-the-dom React Docs,}
